name: General Fund
purpose: Core operations, governance and unfunded programme gaps
conditions: No donor restriction. Board approval required for transfers above KES 2,000,000.

name: USAID / Uraia Election Observation Fund
purpose: Long-term and short-term observation of the 2027 general election
conditions: Costs must be incurred within the agreement period. Unspent balances are returnable within 90 days of close. No sub-granting without prior written approval.

name: DANIDA Civic Education Fund
conditions: Maximum 8% indirect cost recovery. Quarterly narrative and financial reporting. Procurement above KES 1,000,000 requires three quotations.

name: UNDP Basket Fund
purpose: Shared electoral support basket — data systems and call centre
conditions: Pooled reporting with other basket recipients. Assets above USD 5,000 vest in UNDP at close.

name: Ford Foundation Governance Fund
conditions: At least 60% must reach county partners as sub-grants. Final report due 60 days after close.

name: EU Delegation Partner Fund
purpose: Capacity strengthening of county civil society partners
conditions: EU visibility guidelines apply to all outputs. Exchange losses are not eligible.

name: Capital Fund
purpose: Vehicles, ICT equipment and leasehold improvements
conditions: Assets are held for programme use and may not be disposed of without donor consent.

name: ELOG Trust Endowment
purpose: Permanent capital — only investment income may be applied
conditions: Capital is permanently maintained. Only realised investment income may be released to the General Fund, on board resolution.

name: Board Designated Reserve
purpose: Three months of operating cover, designated by the board
conditions: Designated, not restricted. Release requires a board minute but no donor consent.
